checks.note: It names the default argument `cart=[]` as the cause.
It explains that the default is evaluated once, when the function is defined, so calls that don't pass `cart` share and mutate the same list.
The fix uses `cart=None`, then `if cart is None: cart = []`, which is the standard fix.
Only the signature changes and two lines are added. The rest of the function body and the calls are untouched.
The explanation is accurate and short, and the example shows the corrected return values (2, then 10 instead of 12).
